entries.feaa7d757a66af18: The medium-term management plan disclosed in June 2024 explains medium-term performance targets, management strategy and basic policies on the business portfolio. Under the fiscal 2026 management policy “～Passing Tradition on to the Future～,” the company states that it will promote the strengthening of profitability in existing businesses and improvement in productivity, with thoroughgoing customer-focused management at its core. In the Kisoji Department, its core format, it aims to deepen high value-added services centered on celebratory and ceremonial demand (hare no hi), and the Yakiniku Department aims to grow as the second pillar after Kisoji. It states that it will pursue its growth strategy through new store openings, renovation of existing stores, format development and M&A, among other means.
